translations.translatedText: # Saturday 4.5.2019 (radio)

The Swedish prime minister praises the Swedish military aircraft to Finns who are planning to buy aircraft. There is a lot of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Thailand's new king has been crowned. Merim Al-Kharsani's Finnish textbook has been published.
## Swedish prime minister
![Stefan Löfven in a Yle Ykkösaamu interview.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10766841)
Open image viewer
Swedish Prime Minister Stefan Löfven (right) in a Yle interview. Photo: Johanna Östman / Yle
The Swedish prime minister praises the Swedish military aircraft Jas Gripen. Prime Minister Stefan Löfven says that the Jas Gripen is a good military aircraft. Yle interviewed Löfven on Saturday.
Finland intends to buy new military aircraft. Jas Gripen is one option. The Finnish government will decide in 2021 which aircraft Finland buys.

The Swedish prime minister said that Finland makes the decision itself. The relationship between Finland and Sweden does not worsen if Finland buys the aircraft from some other country than Sweden, Löfven said.
Prime Minister Löfven's opinion is, however, that military cooperation between Finland and Sweden is easier if the countries have the same military aircraft.
## Ebola
![A woman washes her hands to protect herself from Ebola in Mbandaka last May.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10767229)
Open image viewer
Good hand hygiene prevents the spread of Ebola. Photo: EPA
Many people have fallen ill with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in Africa. More than 1,000 people have already died.
Ebola is a viral disease. An Ebola patient has, for example, a high fever and bleeding.
Authorities find it hard to stop the spread of Ebola, because there is fighting in the area.
The last time there was a lot of Ebola in Africa was in 2014–2016. Then more than 11,000 people died.
## Thailand's king
![King Maha Vajiralongkorn was crowned on Saturday with a crown weighing over seven kilos on his head.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10767261)
Open image viewer
Thailand's new king was given a heavy crown. Photo: AFP
Thailand's new king Maha Vajiralongkorn has been crowned. A crown weighing more than 7 kilos was placed on the king's head.
The new king started the role already in 2016. Then Thailand's previous king Bhumibol died.
## Merim's textbook
![Woman with a book in her hand](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10766128)
Open image viewer
Merim Al-Kharsani has written a Finnish textbook. Photo: Maria Nykänen / Yle
A new Finnish textbook was published in Tampere on Saturday. The book's name is Opi suomea Merimin kanssa (Learn Finnish with Merim).
The author of the book is 20-year-old Tampere resident Merim Al-Kharsani. In the book Merim teaches Finnish in Arabic.
Merim's family comes from Iraq. That is why Merim speaks Finnish and Arabic.
Merim says that language tells about culture. In Arabic texts, for example, more emotions are used than in Finnish texts.
Merim has already made teaching videos on YouTube. In the videos she teaches Finnish in Arabic.
Merim Al-Kharsani is now studying Finnish at the University of Tampere. Merim hopes that she becomes a Finnish teacher and maybe also a writer.
